in_marathi.name: Bansi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bansi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bansi is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'bamboo flute'. It is a unisex name with a spiritual and mythological origin in Hinduism. The name is associated with the god of music, Saraswati, who holds a bansuri, a type of bamboo flute, in her hands.
